label: flash_debug
command: probe-rs download --speed 4000 --chip STM32F103ZETx build/Debug/stm32_cmake_M3.elf && probe-rs reset --chip STM32F103ZETx

label: flash_release
command: probe-rs download --speed 4000 --chip STM32F103ZETx build/Release/stm32_cmake_M3.elf && probe-rs reset --chip STM32F103ZETx

label: erase chip
command: probe-rs erase --connect-under-reset --chip STM32F103ZETx && probe-rs reset --chip STM32F103ZETx

label: release and flash
command: cmake --preset Release && cmake --build --preset Release -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4) && probe-rs download --speed 4000 --chip STM32F103ZETx build/Release/stm32_cmake_M3.elf && probe-rs reset --chip STM32F103ZETx

label: git: push to both remotes (Gitee + GitHub)
command: git push origin main && git push github main

label: git: pull from both remotes (Gitee + GitHub)
command: git pull origin main && git pull github main
